tools.name: check_trademark
tools.description: Check whether a brand, product or company name is available as a trademark. Searches the USPTO register and scores similar marks by conflict risk. Free, no account needed. Signed-in Arcangel users can set full_report for a full clearance search (US + EU/WIPO, dead marks, domains, common-law). Result

tools.name: get_trademark_check
tools.description: Get the result of a trademark check that was still running, or the next part of a long full report. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned, and part when the report says it continues.

tools.name: suggest_nice_classes
tools.description: Suggest trademark (Nice) classes for a description of goods or services, e.g. "mobile app for booking yoga classes".

tools.name: start_trademark_application
tools.description: Start a US trademark application on Arcangel AI as a draft in the signed-in user's account. Pass what is known (the mark, goods or services, classes, owner); the rest can be added later with update_trademark_application. If a company owns the mark, pass the id of a saved company (list_companies) as

tools.name: update_trademark_application
tools.description: Fill in or change fields on a trademark application draft (owner, address, mark details, classes, use dates, statements). Only fields passed are changed. Returns what the draft still needs, as text. The Arcangel card already in the chat refreshes itself, so there is no need to call get_trademark_app

tools.name: get_trademark_application
tools.description: Show what a trademark application draft still needs before it can be signed and paid for: missing fields, files to upload (logo, specimens) with upload links, and the link to finish on arcangel.ai.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List the companies saved in the signed-in Arcangel account, with their ids. Call this before asking for company details on a trademark application: if the owner is already saved, pass its id as company_id to start_trademark_application or update_trademark_application. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

tools.name: create_company
tools.description: Save a company profile in the signed-in Arcangel account, as on the Companies page, so it can own trademark applications. Every field except address_line2 is required: ask the user for each one, never guess. Returns the new company id; link it to a draft with company_id. Requires Sign in with Arcang

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Change fields on a saved company (id from list_companies). Only the fields passed change. A draft already linked to the company picks up the change when company_id is passed again or the draft is opened on arcangel.ai. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.
